what.text: This page follows refugees from Czechia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 794 refugees from Czechia, and Germany hosted 46.1% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are Canada, France and Denmark.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Czechia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1988 to 1991, 1993 to 1994 and 2002 to 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1970 at 70 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 6985, at the end of 2002.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
